name: One Galle Face Mall
description: Sri Lanka's largest international shopping mall, featuring 7 floors of premier global fashion brands, fine dining, a luxury cinema complex, and entertainment centers.

name: Thilakawardhana Textiles
description: One of Sri Lanka's largest and most famous textile and department store chains, offering massive multi-story showrooms for family apparel, footwear, and accessories.

name: Kalutara Town Promenade & Arcade
description: A bustling coastal commercial hub featuring traditional handloom shops, basketry craft centers, and modern clothing outlets near the Kalu Ganga river.

name: Kandy City Centre (KCC)
description: The premier commercial and shopping complex in Kandy, featuring modern amenities, international brands, a food court, and entertainment venues.

name: Matale Heritage & Spice Street Market
description: A vibrant central bazaar famous for spice trading, traditional textile boutiques, and artisan brassware shops in the heart of Matale city.

name: Grand Hotel Shopping Arcade
description: An elegant colonial-style promenade adjacent to Nuwara Eliya Grand Hotel, featuring high-end Ceylon tea boutiques, warm woolens, and jewelry stores.

name: Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct
description: A heritage 17th-century Dutch colonial courtyard turned upscale shopping, dining, and nightlife venue in Fort Colombo.

name: Matara Dutch Market & Promenade
description: A historic riverside marketplace and modern shopping strip along the Nilwala river featuring local handicrafts, fresh fruit markets, and clothing boutiques.

name: Tangalle City Plaza & Market
description: A bustling southern coast bazaar featuring fresh fish markets, spice vendors, handloom shops, and beachwear stores.

name: Cargills Square
description: Jaffna's major multi-story modern shopping mall containing a multiplex cinema, food court, supermarket, and retail outlets.

name: Kilinochchi Central Town Complex
description: A growing Northern province commercial center featuring local handicraft cooperatives, Palmyra product centers, and textile markets.

name: Mannar Main Street Bazaar
description: A vibrant coastal market street lined with traditional dried fish stalls, Palmyra weave crafts, and local saree boutiques.

name: Mullaitivu Coastal Town Center
description: A serene northern coastal bazaar offering fresh seafood markets, local cottage industry goods, and community shopping arcades.

name: Vavuniya Commercial Plaza
description: A major northern transit city commercial zone featuring lively clothing stores, electronics plazas, and agricultural produce markets.

name: Trincomalee Dutch Bay Promenade & Bazaar
description: A scenic seaside town market with street vendors, local jewelry shops, and harbor-front shopping arcades.

name: Batticaloa Gate & Kallady Shopping Hub
description: A lagoon-side commercial quarter famous for handloom textiles, brassware, and traditional eastern sweets.

name: Kalmunai Commercial Center
description: The largest commercial and trading hub on Sri Lanka's eastern coast, known for textile wholesaling and goldsmith shops.

name: Central Mall Kurunegala
description: A popular multi-story regional shopping mall located in the heart of Kurunegala, featuring modern clothing brands and dining options.

name: Chilaw Town Bazaar
description: A historic coastal market town famous for fresh seafood markets, traditional brassware, and coconut palm crafts.

name: Anuradhapura New Town Arcade
description: The modern commercial zone of Anuradhapura, offering air-conditioned shopping complexes, bank hubs, and souvenir markets.

name: Kaduruwela Commercial Center
description: The main economic and transportation shopping hub of Polonnaruwa district, packed with textile stores and local markets.

name: Ella Main Street Promenade
description: A bohemian mountain town street lined with cozy cafes, artisan craft shops, organic tea houses, and vibrant night spots.

name: Monaragala Central Plaza
description: The primary agricultural trading bazaar in the Uva province, offering rural crafts, fresh fruit markets, and local apparel stores.

name: Ratnapura Gem Market & City Center
description: The world-famous 'City of Gems' open-air street trading market, where dealers gather daily to trade raw sapphires, rubies, and precious stones.

name: Mawanella Spice & Handloom Arcade
description: A famous roadside shopping quarter specializing in organic spice garden products, authentic Ceylon cinnamon, and traditional handloom fabrics.
